description.value: Crystal Cove Beach Resort is a long-established oceanfront resort on MacKenzie Beach in Tofino, offering 34 modern log cabins (several beachfront, with hot tubs and fireplaces), year-round fully serviced RV sites tucked under old-growth trees, and glamping in 5th-wheel trailers. Rated the #1 resort in Tofino by TripAdvisor, it sits steps from a kilometre of sandy coastline with an on-site coffee shop (Bean at the Cove). It is 100% pet-friendly, making it a welcoming base for cycle tourists exploring the remote western coast of Vancouver Island.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms this is an active, open resort on MacKenzie Beach in Tofino offering log cabins, RV camping, and glamping. The contact page corroborates the OSM street address (1165 Cedarwood Place) and supplies phone numbers not present in OSM. No cyclist-specific amenities—bike storage, laundry, Wi-Fi, tools, etc.—are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those fields remain null; OSM power_supply=yes applies to RV hookups and is not sufficient evidence for e-bike charging.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; phone 250-725-4213 (toll-free 1-877-725-4213) was sourced from the website contact page only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly bookable resort with an active website and current operational notices; a clear inclusion as accommodation for touring cyclists in Tofino.
